justification: A depicts a fully articulated anthropomorphic figure with a defined head, arms, and a dense programme of incised motifs (concentric ring, spirals, curved bands, hooked forms) distributed over torso and back, whereas B shows essentially no depicted iconography at all beyond an amorphous blocky mass whose upper lobe can vaguely read as a head. The only possible correspondence is the coarse suggestion of a large head-topped monolithic body, which is far too generic and uncertain to indicate any shared iconographic scheme.
